post.description: Creates an Organiser or Participant account with a salted PBKDF2 password hash.
Checks credentials and stores user ID, role, and name in the server session.

get.summary: List the categories for an event
get.description: Requires a signed-in user. Returns category IDs for use when a Participant enrols.

post.description: Organiser only. The event must belong to the current Organiser. Supply a name, distance label, and non-negative minimum age.

put.description: Organiser only. Replaces the category name, distance label, and minimum age. Categories with enrolments cannot be deleted.

delete.description: Organiser only. Returns 409 Conflict if any enrolment uses this category.

post.description: Participant only. The body must contain the same eventId as the route and a categoryId belonging to that event. A Participant may enrol once per event; new enrolments start as Pending.

get.summary: List enrolments for an owned event
get.description: Organiser only. Returns participant and category details for an event owned by the signed-in Organiser.
Participant only. Returns enrolments for the signed-in Participant, including category and current status.

put.description: Organiser only, for an enrolment in an event they own. Allowed status values are Pending, Confirmed, and Cancelled.

get.description: Available to signed-in Organisers and Participants. Returns event details and any saved banner URL.

post.description: Organiser only. Supply a name, date, location, positive distance, and event type Run, Walk, or Cycle. Description is optional.

get.description: Returns one event by its event ID for a signed-in user.

put.description: Organiser only. Replaces the event fields; the event must belong to the signed-in Organiser. Event type must be Run, Walk, or Cycle and distance must be positive.

delete.description: Organiser only. Returns 409 Conflict while the event has enrolments; delete is limited to the event owner.

get.description: Organiser only. Returns events created by the signed-in Organiser.

post.description: Organiser owner only. Send one JPG, PNG, or WebP image, up to 5 MB, as multipart form field 'file'. The API stores it in Azure Blob Storage and saves its URL on the event.

get.description: Returns the stored banner image for an event. Requires a signed-in user.
Returns the signed-in user's own profile, including their role and saved profile-image URL.

put.description: Updates the signed-in user's name, email, phone number, and date of birth. Email must not already belong to another user.

post.description: Send one JPG, PNG, or WebP image, up to 5 MB, as multipart form field 'file'. The API stores it in Azure Blob Storage and saves its URL on the signed-in user's profile.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's stored profile image.

post.description: Organiser only, for an enrolment in an event they own. The route and body enrolment IDs must match. Enter finish time in minutes when available; status must be Completed, DNF, DNS, or Disqualified. Only one result is allowed per enrolment.

get.description: Participant only. Returns results linked to the signed-in Participant's enrolments.

get.summary: List results for an owned event
get.description: Organiser only. Returns results for enrolments in an event owned by the signed-in Organiser.
